verdict.rationale: Mangopay's docs say its wallet infrastructure can 'receive, hold, split, and transfer funds' across an unlimited number of wallets, and that platform fees are collected and wired to the platform monthly. Together that covers routing one charge to multiple sellers and taking a cut. Reversal is evidenced only through chargebacks deducted from wallets, not through a documented way to reverse or adjust a split. Missing for 10: explicit first-class Transfer/fee API objects for multi-party splits, documented reversal or adjustment of a split (e.g. transfer refunds), and independent or hands-on corroboration of split routing.
